prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / precise illustration refinement.
EDIT IMAGE 1, the silver-haired imperial fantasy archer. Clean up its overly busy, over-highlighted rendering using the successful balance and clarity of IMAGE 2.
Image 1 is the AUTHORITATIVE edit target: preserve his identity, facial features, expression, pale silver long hair, crown, costume, bow-drawing pose, anatomical proportions, hands, bow, arrow, composition and palace setting.
Image 2 is ONLY the desired degree of clean painterly material handling, calm large shapes, restrained detail, and power concentrated into a few luminous focal areas. Do NOT copy its character, horse, polearm, color palette or red storm. Do not add a horse.

PRIMARY GOAL:
A polished high-end 2D semi-real fantasy illustration with luxurious highest-tier presence, clear beautiful character drawing, natural hair, rich but organized costume and weapon detail. Remove the sense of effects and glitter being smeared over the whole image. Keep it magnificent and colorful, not dull, flat, grey or stripped of power.

HAIR — MOST IMPORTANT:
The silver hair must be NATURAL SOFT HUMAN HAIR. Remove stacked layers, separate thick outlined curls, blade-like white plates, ribbon-shaped locks, step-like tiers, and the dense web of luminous flyaways. Repaint as one connected organic flowing hair volume, soft continuous roots-to-ends movement, subtle fine strands, smooth gradual shading, a restrained satin sheen. Do not individually outline every strand. No hard white highlight bands, metallic hair, noodle curls or rigid flowing ribbons. Keep the existing silver color, long length, natural crown volume, wind direction and forehead shape; preserve the face. Only a few fine wisps around an otherwise calm continuous silhouette. The crown is hard metal; the hair must clearly be soft.

ARMOR AND CLOTH:
Retain the same black, antique gold, ivory and crimson costume designs and their luxurious phoenix-like decorative motifs. Simplify excess tiny etching, scratch texture, isolated gold speckles and repetitive micro-ornament. Paint broad clean black armor plates and confident gold bevels. Preserve a few elaborate focal ornaments on shoulders, waist and bow. Use soft controlled metal reflections, not burning orange edges on every plate.
Ivory and crimson fabric should read as matte flowing silk with broad coherent folds and clearly grouped sweeping motion. Reduce distracting hairline gold textile patterns and tiny highlight streaks; retain the main embroidered motifs and primary fabric silhouettes. Do not add ribbons or shred the cloth. Keep bright ivory cloth naturally ivory, not self-illuminated.

BOW, STRING AND POSE — LOCKED:
Preserve the bow's large scale, matched upper/lower limb proportions, exact pearl-white blade/gold structure/crimson crystal design, both visible bow tips and complete arrowhead. Keep the current one straight arrow and exactly two taut string segments from both limb tips to the drawing fingers/nock. Maintain correct hand grip and nocking geometry. Do NOT bend, resize or redesign the bow or alter his draw pose.
Concentrate brilliant energy in the golden arrow shaft, arrowhead and small bow cores. Bright precise golden light with limited bloom, still readable as a straight narrow arrow. No broad screen-covering beam. This focused light provides his SSS-caliber force.

LIGHTING AND BACKGROUND:
Preserve the sumptuous sunset palace and original warm/cool mood, but make the distant architecture and clouds softly painted low-contrast supporting shapes. Remove excessively crisp tiny windows, all-over glints, surface sparkle, drifting flecks, ember clutter and unnecessary light streaks. Keep beautiful atmospheric depth.
Give the face readable neutral-warm skin shading, clean eyes and a smooth illustrated finish. No glossy skin, no harsh red cast. Calm continuous highlights on hair and armor, no sharpened halos. Keep selectively vivid gold, ivory and red; maintain rich deep blacks. Character and bow must be the immediate focal points, with open quieter supporting areas.

Retain the original camera, crop, identity, pose, weapon anatomy and sophisticated character design. One coherent full-bleed portrait in 1024x1536 or larger exact 2:3, RGB PNG. No text, watermark, logo, rank label, border, UI or panels.
